OK, team, listen. This is the plan for our city. In the middle there is a very tall tower. Next to the tower there is a red bridge over the river. There are three streets: one in front of the tower, one behind it, and one on the left. There are two fire trucks, and they are under the bridge. Please do not put any cars on the bridge yet. The bridge is not finished.

I have a problem. I am building the roof of my house and there is one piece missing. It is a small red brick. I looked in the box and it is not there. I looked under the table and it is not there either. Then I looked on the shelf, behind the big blue box, and there it was. My little sister put it there. Now the roof is finished and my city has eleven houses.
